Milan (MXP) has NO clean option -- Google Flights API errors on this destination (real tool bug, not a data gap) and Kiwi only surfaces a 3-stop budget itinerary ($386, via Stockholm/Tirana) -- not realistic. Checking Turkish's own IST-VCE timetable via ITA Matrix for a same-ticket earlier-connection fix (in progress).
